description: Implementation of the DecodedAudioQueue class for managing audio buffers in a media player, including methods for appending, reading, peeking, and seeking audio frames.

classes.name: DecodedAudioQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of decoded audio buffers, allowing reading, peeking, and seeking within the audio data.

methods.name: DecodedAudioQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the audio queue.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers and resets the queue state.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a decoded audio buffer to the queue.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads a specified number of frames from the queue into a destination buffer.

methods.name: PeekFrames
methods.description: Peeks at a specified number of frames without advancing the read position.

methods.name: SeekFrames
methods.description: Seeks forward by a specified number of frames.

methods.name: InternalRead
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual reading or peeking of frames from the buffers.
